# Vision

widget builds a bill of materials from a parts list.
Makers who price a build read it before they buy.
It owns the priced bill and nothing past the bill.

## Price before purchase

- It prices the build alone, it never orders a part, and it takes the trade of a bill that never leaves the desk.

## One file in, one bill out

- It reads a single parts file, it never merges catalogues, and it takes the trade of one bill per file.

## Scope

- Ordering belongs to the shop, and stock belongs to the inventory tool.

A change aligns when it makes the bill cheaper to trust.
A change should be resisted when it moves the bill past pricing into buying or keeping stock.
